verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has a dedicated glTF importer with deep-dive docs and lists OBJ, STL and .babylon as supported model formats. It also ships exporter plugins for 3ds Max, Maya and Blender, and a community user reports Blender model data 'just works'. However, nothing in the evidence shows FBX or USD import, so DCC assets must be routed through exporters or glTF conversion rather than imported directly. Missing for 10: native FBX import, USD import, independent hands-on corroboration that glTF imports cleanly.
